title: Triangle inequality for statistical distance
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, and let $p$, $q$, and $r$ be probability distributions on $\Omega$. Then $d_{\mathrm{stat}}(p,r)\le d_{\mathrm{stat}}(p,q)+d_{\mathrm{stat}}(q,r)$.
